name: lemo-opuscar
description: Make a film in one of the library's code-rendered styles: your agent directs, draws, scores and mixes it.

interface.shortDescription: Make a short film in code, in one of 99 styles
interface.longDescription: A library of 99 film styles. Pick one, give a topic, and the agent writes the treatment, draws the frames, scores, voices, mixes and renders the film entirely in code, with no video model.
defaultPrompt: Make a 60-second explainer about my topic in the Watercolor Brush style.
Help me make my own film style from a blank page.
